decisions.evidence: Accepted reader repair after checking F1/F2/L1 exact definitions and the full four-step calculation. Oriented spatial pullbacks give i_b vol_h and i_e vol_h; determinant differentiation gives divergence and parallel volume without higher regularity. Epsilon contraction has the Lorentzian minus sign. Skew C gives symmetric off-diagonal S, spectrum 0,0,+r,+r,-r,-r (all zero at xi=0), positive symbol only on zeta(n)>|zeta_perp|, and positive lapse time matrix. Metric/frame derivatives are zero-order in the enlarged first-order state. No global tetrad or potential is assumed; draft model scope retained.

Amended reader repair after all six steps and F1–F4/L1 supplier Statements. Strong H(s-1) endpoint follows by Fourier projection and uniform derivative bound; finite sums preserve Hs bounds; compact membership passes by C0 embedding. Original wording inferred full equations and H=0 from arbitrary reduced evolution: unconstrained reduced data need not give a full solution. Retained general reduced continuation and explicitly conditioned full continuation on original compatibility, H=0 and full equations. Endpoint constraints then pass in H(s-2) by supplied estimates and local H2/H3 estimates. Corrected restarted C3/C2 regularity reference to F1 proof 4.1. Reverse-time uniform difference energy identifies the overlap without strong Hs convergence. Finite endpoints must be interior to coefficient-time domain. Only direct reference consumer is the local A page; its continuation and stability summary remains valid. No outside consumer or withdrawal.

Amended reader repair: checked the reduced residual and finite-jet transfer at C3 metric/C2 field, conserved Maxwell stress, and initial H=0. E(n,n)=one half normal derivative H_n has the correct signature sign; mixed projections supply the other three components. Made the proof choose a chart normal at the base point so positive inverse spatial block follows by continuity, since spacelike levels alone do not imply that block condition with arbitrary shift. Symmetric energy flux is nonnegative for lambda>M/a; zero energy on forward and reversed cones proves local uniqueness. Direct consumers construct H=0 by the explicit jet and meet regularity; no interface change in this amendment. No empirical or completeness assertion.

Amended reader repair: checked seven steps and all 15 actual supplier interfaces. Initialization is Hs because h is H(s+1); zero-shift initial inverse blocks are positive. Commutator ODE preserves q=background derivative g, giving the extra metric spatial derivative. Endpoint H2/H3 convolution estimates and H3 composition are supplied locally, with H2 embedded C0, so ptt and mixed metric derivatives give C3 g and C2 F at s=5. Included the explicit partial-time term in differentiating R(t,x,U,partial U); it has the same harmless lower-order bound and vanishes for autonomous coefficients. Local arbitrary-slice jet is computed explicitly, then cutoff extensions preserve positivity/symmetry without requiring exterior constraints. Recovery is local in the cutoff-one region, smooth persistence uses the same base interval, and stability is only H(s-1). Read actual GR existence, embedding, algebra, composition, persistence and stability Statements; their missing audit markers remain separate maintenance. All direct uses (local uniqueness, continuation, example, outside pthm-emg-local-electrovacuum-model F6, and A summary) retain precisely these clauses; proof-only amendment needs no interface propagation.

Accepted reader repair after all four steps and F1/F2/F3/L1 interfaces checked. C1 metric/normal/field suffice for continuous U,V, distributional d2=0 and the trace formula. Transverse C1 normal has a C1 local flow by the exact ODE/IFT suppliers; weak closedness pulls back using change of variables and C1 test approximation. Continuous Jq,Jr have zero time derivative and zero initial data, giving zero on local flow cylinders. Only local neighborhoods, no uniform noncompact time width, no Einstein equation or stress conservation is invoked.

Accepted reader repair after all five steps and exact complete-model supplier thm-gr-local-geometric-development Statement and proof were read. Six tensorial components on RN plus TΣ specify full matter data without a potential. Local jet computation with a smooth background gives H0=0; choose flat gamma locally to meet the generic supplier flat-comparison formulation. Coupled symbol positivity, local full recovery and conserved stress are verified before invoking the generic development theorem, without circular use of Einstein equations. Maxwell pullback, Hodge covariance for orientation-preserving comparisons and algebraic stress preserve the fixed model. AComega/DC support countable locally finite collar patching; uniqueness fixes future normal and F. Variable width is essential on noncompact Σ. The repaired causal clause is used only with its actual hypotheses; no use needs the old unrestricted sequence claim. No empirical or global-time claim.
